hero.title: When every connection matters.
hero.body: Explore active blood requests across Negros Island Region, see what each one needs, and find the right coordination point to respond — without exposing anyone’s private details.

assurances.noAccount: No account needed to view requests

hero.mapLabel: Preview map of active requests in Negros Island Region

trust.title: Clear about what you’re seeing — and what you’re not.
trust.body: Request status and availability can change at any time. Each request shows when it was last updated and how to reach its authorized coordination point.

current.title: Current request information
current.body: Every request carries an updated-at time and an expiry. Expired and closed requests leave the map automatically — they’re never shown as active.

authorized.title: Authorized coordination
authorized.body: Only authorized coordinators can publish a request after reviewing what was submitted. Responses go through listed coordination points, not private numbers.

privacy.title: Privacy-conscious locations
privacy.body: Requests appear at a city or an authorized facility. Patient names, home addresses and exact coordinates are never displayed publicly.
privacy.proof: City-level area, never a home address

how.title: Three steps from finding a request to the right desk.

discover.title: Discover an active request
discover.body: Search by city or municipality and filter by blood type. The map and list stay in sync.

review.title: Review its details and requirements
review.body: See the blood type, units stated by the requester, the time window, freshness and expiry.

follow.title: Follow the verified coordination steps
follow.body: Contact the listed coordination point. Qualified staff there handle screening and eligibility.

region.title: Built first for Negros Island Region.
region.body: BloodMap starts with the three provinces of NIR so coordination stays local and manageable. Select an area to explore.
region.demoDisclaimer: Counts are fictional demonstration data and don’t reflect real activity in any city.

safety.title: A coordination tool — not a blood bank or a medical service.
safety.body: BloodMap never promises that blood is available or that a donor can give. Here’s how the interface keeps that clear.

status.title: Request status, always labelled
status.body: Every request shows one of seven statuses with an icon and words — never color alone.

freshness.title: Freshness and expiry
freshness.body: Requests show when they were last updated and expire automatically if nobody confirms them.

contact.title: Contact and privacy
contact.body: Only authorized coordination points are listed. Donor and patient contact details are never public.
contact.proof: Desk contact visible after sign-in · personal numbers never shown

medical.title: Medical eligibility
medical.body: Whether someone can donate is decided by qualified professionals at the facility — not by BloodMap or its assistant.
medical.proof: Eligibility is assessed by qualified staff on-site.

cta.title: See what’s needed near you
cta.body: Browse active requests in NIR — no account required.

footer.overview: A blood-request discovery and coordination platform for Negros Island Region. Built to help people find active requests and the right place to respond.
footer.disclaimer: BloodMap NIR is an independent student portfolio project and a coordination tool. It is not a blood bank, a medical provider, or affiliated with any government agency or humanitarian organization. All requests in this demo are fictional.
